text.content:
• Board-dry code audit find, 2026-09-04.
• publicData.ts fetchCoaches() has no .order() clause - coaches render in whatever order Supabase returns (insertion order). Rankings page sorts by MMR; this is inconsistent and means the first coach to sign up is permanently top of the list.
• Fix: add an .order() - e.g. by years_experience desc, or hourly_rate, or just created_at desc so newest listings surface. Low impact until there are more than a handful of coaches.
• Also noted this session (not a row): npm audit flags browserslist high-sev, but it is a dev-only transitive dep (eslint-plugin-react-hooks > @babel/core), not in the runtime or build bundle, and npm audit fix cannot reach it without --force. Not exploitable for CourtConnect - left alone.
